text: Kaatil ne sab saaf\nkiya... bas ek cheez\npeechhe chhoot gayi!
Clue isi video mein hai.\nDhyaan se dekhna!
Raat ke khaane par\nNana ji study se\nnahi aaye
Kursi ke paas farsh\npar ek button\npada tha
Usi subah Nana ji ne\nPooja ki shaadi ki\nbaat thukra di thi
NAATIN POOJA\n"Main aarti ki thaali\nsaja rahi thi"
SHARMA AUNTY\n"Main apne ghar\nTV dekh rahi thi"
NAATI RAJAT\n"Shaam se apne\nkamre mein tha"
NAUKAR RAMU\n"7 baje study mein\nnaashta diya tha"
Shivam ki nazar se\nkoi nahi bachta.
